items.why: 设计方案未给出 0.73 的任何来源: 既非基线锚定, 也非运维要求, 也非文献惯例; 等预算 HPO 修复后实测最强基线 MLP F1=0.4970, 0.73 高出 0.2330, 在本任务上不可达。
8 ms 无业务来源; 更严重的是口径未定义: 现有 measure_efficiency 测的是"整图一次前向" (实测 33.3 ms / 203769 节点 = 0.16 µs/节点), 与"单笔交易 8 ms"不是一个量, 无法比较。
0.60 / 1.00 的切点无推导, 且存在灰区, 硬切会把噪声判成结论
5% / 8% 无告警成本模型支撑; 且当前攻击实验是 oracle 注入式, 不是真实自适应攻击

changelog.change: 初版登记: H1–H5, 其中 H4 的判定规则栏误写入攻击描述
H4 重述为时间外推(区间估计); 攻击项拆出单列为 H6, 标为开放项, 不参与 all_pass
changelog.note: 拆分只是修正误归档。H4 在 v1 与 v2 中都没有 gate, H1/H2/H5 的门限数值完全不变, 因此不改变任何已有判决

changelog.change: H6 从 not_testable 升级为"预登记测量协议 + 区间报告": 在执行攻击矩阵之前锁定攻击清单、攻击者知识、配对单位与聚合方式
changelog.note: H6 仍然没有 gate: 告警容量锚点缺失, 任何通过线都会是任意值。H1/H2/H5 的门限数值一字未动, 因此不改变任何已有判决

third_dataset.temporal: non-temporal components only; it cannot test temporal extrapolation

rows.rule_source: early design document; audited as arbitrary (results/p4/threshold_justification.json)
rows.consequence: Kept for historical contrast only. V0 has no source, so no gate verdict from this protocol is reused.
Descriptive only. Oracle edge injection means the relative drop cannot be read as adversarial robustness.

rows.rule_source: thresholds were never written to the artifact; the decision code is paper_evidence.py sha256=a1d8e2203f12560b8d9e6092
rows.consequence: The H2, H3 and H5 passes are passes under the withdrawn rule: H2 used a full-graph 8 ms budget and H5 used overall ECE. They are not comparable with the Table III verdicts.

"No eligible candidate" is rule-dependent: the candidates failed f1_min=0.73, a withdrawn threshold, and the V0 full-graph 8 ms latency semantics. It must not be read as "no candidate is eligible under the registered rule".
The only result set in this paper judged under sourced thresholds. H1, H2 and H5 are gates; H3 and H4 are interval estimates.

rows.rule_source: threshold values taken from the Elliptic anchor (e10ba4b3df3a9392a943365a); not re-derived on this dataset
rows.consequence: Any pass must be written as "under a borrowed rule". It is not a gate confirmation on this dataset, because the non-inferiority anchor came from baselines on another dataset.

rows.rule_source: results/p5/dgraphfin_probe.json; edge_timestamp_only, no per-transaction time step
rows.consequence: With no per-transaction time step the TASGL temporal component is degenerate and no temporal split exists, so H4 does not apply. Only the non-temporal components can be tested here.
